items.passage: Transcript: Good morning, this is Cosima Haddad from the sustainability office with a note about Wednesday's farmers' market. The lawn by the main library is being reseeded, so this week the stalls move indoors to Sablewood Pavilion, which opens to us at nine thirty. Shopping hours stay the same, eleven to three. Volunteers usually sign in at ten thirty, but carrying tables inside takes longer, so please come at ten this week. The one exception is the herb sellers' team: their carts stay out on the pavilion's back terrace, so those volunteers can keep the usual time. The free tote bags work differently, too. Normally the first fifty shoppers through the gate get one. This week, a tote goes to anyone who shows receipts from two different stalls at the information table, until they run out. Volunteer questions go to extension 9423.
items.prompt: [Announcement — Campus farmers' market] What should a shopper do to get a free tote bag?
choices: Show receipts from two different stalls at the information table
Be among the first fifty shoppers to come through the gate
Show a receipt from the herb sellers out on the back terrace
Show one receipt of any amount at the information table
items.correct_answer: Show receipts from two different stalls at the information table
items.explanation: The speaker says, 'This week, a tote goes to anyone who shows receipts from two different stalls at the information table.' 'Be among the first fifty shoppers to come through the gate' is the usual arrangement ('Normally the first fifty shoppers through the gate get one'), which does not apply this week. 'Show a receipt from the herb sellers out on the back terrace' attaches the herb sellers' location to the tote rule; the terrace is only where their carts stay. 'Show one receipt of any amount at the information table' has the right place but the wrong condition: two receipts from different stalls are required.
